issue.title: Is npm@3 not handling version collisions very well?

repository.name: npm
repository.description: This repository is moving to: https://github.com/npm/cli

issue.body:
I have a project that has eslint as a devDependency: 

```
...
"devDependencies": {
    "browser-sync": "^2.9.4",
    "eslint": "^1.5.0",
    "eslint-plugin-react": "^3.4.2",
    "gulp-eslint": "^1.0.0",
    "jasmine-core": "^2.3.4",
    "karma": "^0.13.9",
    "karma-browserify": "^4.3.0",
    "karma-chrome-launcher": "^0.2.0",
    "karma-jasmine": "^0.3.6",
    "run-sequence": "^1.1.3",
    "watchify": "^3.4.0"
  },
...
```

It all worked fine until I tried to update NPM from 2 to 3 and then run `npm update` in the project. After NPM did it's thing to re-arrange all `node_modules` structure to the newer, flatter and optimized structure, the `eslint` package stopped working, throwing the following error:

```
/Users/abaptista/projects/hu-site-mobile-next/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:517
                        throw new Error('Unknown node type ' + nodeType + '.');
                        ^
...
```

As I thought was an issue with the `eslint` package, I went on it's repo trying to find a fix or open an issue to find out it's an error that has been fixed for a [long time](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/1965).

Looking into the new `node_modules` structure I found out that the version that NPM installs of `estraverse` it's the `1.9.3`, but the version `eslint` requires it's `^4.1.0`, I guessing it's some kind of version collision that NPM3 is not handling well, could it be?

issue.title: npm3 script, use deprecated version of estraverse

repository.name: standard
repository.description: 🌟 JavaScript Style Guide, with linter & automatic code fixer

issue.body:
I'm having  `ExportDefaultDeclaration` error with npm3 using standard v5.3.1 in npm script ... but no error when using it in cli!

This bug [is resolved](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/1965).

But with npm3, when using standard via a npm script, a deprecated version of estraverse (see https://github.com/RReverser/estraverse-fb/issues/5) is used.

It's related on how npm3 resolves dependencies. I did not checked the dependency tree to check if there is peer dependencies...

It's not a bug in standard, but I created an issue here to avoid anyone to spend too much time to track this down.

issue.body:
I met this phenomenon use eslint@1.7.3 with browserify@12.0.1.
# Cause

I think a cause is that `estraverse-fb` use peerDependencies.
https://github.com/RReverser/estraverse-fb/blob/master/package.json#L19
# Steps to Reproduce
## npm install

```
npm i browserify eslint
```
## .eslintrc

```
{
  "env": {
    "es6": true
  },
  "ecmaFeatures": {
    "modules": true
  }
}
```
## log.js

```
export default function(...rest){
  console.log(...rest)
}
```
## Run

```
node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js log.js
```
